### Bounded web demonstration source

A web learning example consumes a build-time projection of an explicitly selected canonical item, not manually maintained question, answer, Reason or Details text in JSX. The projection binds track/item identity, exact content version and artifact checksum to the existing release lock and admission evidence. Its source owner validates the canonical item and current ordinary Free-node/mode pool membership; artifact membership alone does not widen preview access. Missing items, mismatched pins or an item outside the allowed scope fail explicitly before export/build, without substituting another item or silently updating the pin.

Only the intended bounded sample is included in the web bundle; no whole question bank, runtime content fetch, parallel content authority or app session runner is introduced. Stable authored option IDs preserve correct/wrong feedback under permitted display permutations. Answer-specific Reason and Details follow the recorded demo answer, and reset removes the prior response and expanded Details. A single example establishes neither full-track coverage nor exam/interview readiness.

Local projection, implementation and verification do not grant public marketing-use or publication authorization. Ordinary Free practice does not authorize Mock, Exam or Design/Premium sessions, and public release still requires the existing applicable authorization. This contract changes no Premium, content admission, publication, deployment or service configuration rule.
